paragraphs.text: Ghalma , the Shaper, is a loxodon artificer from Mirrodin .
Metal seems to flow like a liquid under her touch, allowing her to sculpt metal objects without a forge. She uses this power to craft toys, trinkets, and small artifact creatures.
Ghalma survived the advent of New Phyrexia and was responsible for creating Razor Circle Passages used by survivors in the Razor Fields to access other refugees in the Furnace Layer .
